title: "Community of St. Mary the Virgin, Wantage, The"
other_id: 21
---

**Type:** organization

## Description

This sisterhood was founded by the Rev. [W. J. Butler](../people/person_244.qmd) in 1848.  CMY became an Associate, as did many members of the Gosling Society. The community still exists and its website is http://orders.anglican.org/arcyb/csmv.html
